notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
